name: Aquabreeze Blessing: Vortex
description:
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Hydro Dice and 2 Anemo Dice.
When you trigger Swirl reaction(s): Deal +1 DMG to the target character and heal the most damaged character on your side for 1 HP. (Twice per Round)
